title: Business Location and the Marketing Mix

flashcard_questions.q: Items that consumers buy frequently and with minimal effort, such as milk or newspapers.
The number of people walking past or through a location, which affects a business's potential sales.
The supply of workers available to a business in a given area, including their skills, availability, and wage expectations.

flashcard_questions.a: A product that is smaller or lighter than the raw materials used to make it, such as orange juice made from bulk oranges.
When businesses in the same industry group together in one area to attract more customers, such as the Birmingham Jewellery Quarter.
